name: Lo Ruhamah
overview: In Hosea 1:6-8, God commands Hosea to name his daughter Lo Ruhamah, meaning 'not having obtained mercy,' signifying that God will no longer extend mercy to the house of Israel and will remove them due to their unfaithfulness. However, in contrast, God promises mercy and salvation to the house of Judah, emphasizing His sovereign choice and the means of their deliverance not by military power but by the LORD Himself. The naming of Lo Ruhamah serves as a prophetic symbol of God's judicial mercy withdrawal from Israel while highlighting His grace toward Judah.
